# 1. Sponsor Zheng He Imperial Treasure Voyages & Claim Maritime Silk Mantle
oe_pmng_dec_sponsor_treasure_voyages = {
	decision_category = oe_cat_celestial_mandate
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		oe_pmng_is_host = yes
		current_year >= 1405
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_dec_voyage_done }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pmng_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		gold >= 300
		has_non_rural_port = yes
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = exterior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:burghers background = pop_type:soldiers } }
	option = {
		name = oe_pmng_dec_sponsor_treasure_voyages.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_pmng_dec_sponsor_treasure_voyages_tt
			add_gold = -300
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_dec_voyage_done value = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmng_took_maritime_mantle value = 1 }
			oe_pmng_add_haijin = { amt = 30 }
			add_navy_tradition = 10
			add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmng_mod_treasure_voyages years = 25 mode = replace }
		}
	}
}

# 3. Fortify the Guanning-Jinzhou Hongyi Cannon Line (repeatable up to Tier 4, 10y cooldown)
oe_pmng_dec_fortify_guanning_line = {
	decision_category = oe_cat_celestial_mandate
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		oe_pmng_is_host = yes
		current_year >= 1580
		OR = {
			owns = location:ningyuan_jinzhou
			owns = location:funing
			owns = location:dadu
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_pmng_guanning }
			var:oe_pmng_guanning < 4
		}
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pmng_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		gold >= 220
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pmng_guanning_cd_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_guanning_cd }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = armed 10 = exterior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:soldiers background = pop_type:nobles } }
	option = {
		name = oe_pmng_dec_fortify_guanning_line.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_pmng_dec_fortify_guanning_line_tt
			add_gold = -220
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_guanning_cd value = 1 years = 10 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_shenji_ready value = 1 }
			oe_pmng_add_guanning = { amt = 1 }
			add_army_tradition = 8
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmng_mod_guanning_bastion years = 25 mode = replace }
			if = {
				limit = { owns = location:ningyuan_jinzhou }
				location:ningyuan_jinzhou = {
					add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmng_loc_ningyuan_fortress years = 25 mode = replace }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { owns = location:funing }
				location:funing = {
					add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmng_loc_ningyuan_fortress years = 25 mode = replace }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_manchu_pass
					has_global_variable = oe_pmch_pass_pressure
				}
				change_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_pass_pressure add = -10 }
				clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_pass_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }
			}
		}
	}
}
